question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 A 组：韩国 vs 捷克，90 分钟三路赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group A: Korea Republic vs Czechia, three-way 90-minute result?
one_liner_cn: 韩国凭 18 分 Elo 微弱优势和更稳的晋级路径略占上风，但三路概率接近，平局风险不低。
one_liner_en: Korea hold a slight edge from an 18-point Elo gap and a steadier qualification path, but all three outcomes are close and the draw risk is material.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距仅 18 分（韩国 1758 vs 捷克 1740），统计上接近抛硬币，韩国仅微弱领先。
key_reasons.en: The Elo gap is only 18 points (Korea 1758 vs Czechia 1740) — statistically near a coin flip with Korea marginally ahead.

key_reasons.cn: 韩国预选赛不败直通且核心健康、孙兴慜状态出色；捷克靠附加赛两轮点球险胜晋级，20 年来首进世界杯。
key_reasons.en: Korea qualified unbeaten with a healthy core and an in-form Son Heung-min; Czechia needed two penalty shootouts in the play-offs and are at their first World Cup in 20 years.

key_reasons.cn: 捷克 Hlozek 伤愈进入名单，进攻端有补强，限制了向韩国方向的调整幅度。
key_reasons.en: Czechia's Adam Hlozek recovered to make the squad, bolstering the attack and capping the size of the shift toward Korea.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus; p_stat 0.390/0.259/0.351) plus a bounded +2pp Korea / -2pp Czechia evidence adjustment, renormalized. Probabilities derived solely from the statistical model and cited public evidence.
